span.p: questions the corpus cannot answer show which papers to collect next

div.style: color: rgb(13, 49, 90) !important; font-size: 22px !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: MUFASA GraphRAG Retrieval Layer

div.style: color: rgb(18, 59, 24) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
0 - Records from Layer 1
One flagship domain, about 200 rights-cleared papers
Parsed with GROBID and OCR, tables and page anchors kept
Build plane - your machine, internet allowed

div.style: color: rgb(93, 69, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
1 - Build the knowledge graph
Every measurement becomes an Observation node
value, unit, baseline, conditions, uncertainty, review status
Observation to Material, Property, EvidenceSpan, Paper
One experiment is one StudyFamily, however often published

div.style: color: rgb(93, 69, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
2 - Add the helpers
Alias list: onugbu, ewuro, bitter leaf, RHA
Full-text index for exact terms
Vectors for paraphrase and other languages

div.style: color: rgb(101, 16, 54) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
3 - Quality gate
Extraction sampled and human-checked?
Units normalised, every span reaches a paper?

div.style: color: rgb(51, 51, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Fix extraction
or normalisation

div.style: color: rgb(93, 69, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
4 - Ship the package
Ladybug graph, full-text and vectors, quoted spans
Ladybug extensions bundled - they download over the network
Versioned, hashed and measured as corpus v1

div.style: color: rgb(18, 59, 24) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

p.i: Runtime plane - the laptop, no internet, 7 GB ceiling

div.style: color: rgb(13, 49, 90) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
6 - Find the way in
Intent and entities from rules and the alias list
No model needed for this step

div.style: color: rgb(13, 49, 90) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
7 - Retrieve
Full-text and vector search in parallel
then ONE hop through the graph
If vectors fail to load, full-text and graph still answer

div.style: color: rgb(13, 49, 90) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
8 - Tidy the results
One experiment counted once, not four times
Group observations that share conditions
Name the condition that differs when they disagree

div.style: color: rgb(101, 16, 54) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

p.b:
9 - Is there matching evidence
in corpus v1?

div.style: color: rgb(93, 69, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
9b - Report coverage, not novelty
No verified matching evidence in corpus v1
214 papers, this domain, these years
Show the nearest related evidence

div.style: color: rgb(93, 69, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
10 - Short list for MUFASA
6 to 10 Observations tagged E1, E2, E3
Value, units, conditions and the quoted span
Short on purpose - prompt reading dominates CPU latency

div.style: color: rgb(52, 16, 77) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
11 - MUFASA writes the answer
llama.cpp, 4-bit model file, short by default
Cites the tags it was given

div.style: color: rgb(0, 70, 77) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
12 - Validate before display
Numbers, units and tags
match their evidence?

div.style: color: rgb(51, 51, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Retry that claim once,
then soften the answer

div.style: color: rgb(60, 15, 79) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
13 - Answer
Click a claim, read the quoted sentence and its page
Coverage card: corpus v1, N papers, years, countries
